ValidationRule.description: Cases created from Inbox can access the 'Inbox Email' value.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.CaseValidations__c ) , ISPICKVAL( Origin , 'Inbox Email' ) , ISPICKVAL( NSP_Topic__c , '' ) , OR( ISNEW() , ISCHANGED( Origin ) , ISCHANGED( NSP_Topic__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Value is only used on Cases created from Inbox.
